Department Overview

The Supply Chain M&A Department drives growth and operational continuity by managing end-to-end supply chain strategy across mergers and acquisitions. We lead comprehensive due diligence to identify synergies and manage risks, while executing seamless integration strategies across procurement, logistics, and operations to ensure the full value of every deal is realized. Central to our mission is supporting newly acquired team members—delivering a welcoming, structured transition that helps them acclimate quickly to MSI’s culture, systems, and operations.
Job Description
The successful candidate will take primary accountability for post-signing integration planning and execution, allowing the team to flex bandwidth between diligence and integration as deal flow requires. Given our unique alignment under the CFO, this individual will bridge the gap between operational supply chain execution and hard financial metrics, ensuring all acquired businesses successfully scale to meet our Vision 2030 goals.

- Integration Strategy & Execution: Lead end-to-end post-signing integration activities, designing and executing Day 1 readiness plans, 100-day integration roadmaps, and TSA exit strategies.

- Financial Modeling & Synergy Tracking: Partner closely with Corp Dev and FP&A to build models for ROI, operating costs, and capital investments.

- Post-Merger Value Realization: Rigorously track and report on synergy commitments to withstand executive and CFO scrutiny while driving committed business outcomes.

- Executive Reporting: Establish robust, comprehensive, and repeatable status updates, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms for the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and broader business units.

- Cross-Functional Consensus: Drive alignment, operational prioritization, and change management across cross-functional integration teams, including Go-To-Market (GTM), Sales, Product, HR, IT, and Supply Chain.

- Portfolio Scaling: Initially manage integration within the Supply Chain and Business Operations ecosystem (including, but not limited to hardware, software, and services across international and domestic targets), with the explicit expectation to expand scope into IT integration over time.

- Execution & Strategy Mix : Address the integration backlog while developing and implementing an integration playbook and center of excellence and planning and executing the integration of new acquisitions.

Experience:
- Proven track record of leading corporate post-merger integrations (PMI) either within a corporate environment or through a top-tier management consulting firm.

- Practical, hands-on experience managing complex M&A integration lifecycles (Day 1, 100-day plans, synergy capturing).

- Demonstrated experience in supply chain/operations, though diverse industry backgrounds (e.g., tech, industrial, consumer, healthcare, financial services) will be considered if accompanied by strong PMI mastery.

- Strong financial acumen with the ability to translate operational milestones into P&L impact (revenue retention, working capital, ROI).

- Expert-level project management capabilities, including utilization of modern integration and synergy tracking tools.

- Outstanding communication skills, with a verified ability to comfortably present to and influence executive stakeholders, targets, and cross-functional peers.

Job Description
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “ Keeping Our Heroes Connected ”?

THE OPPORTUNITY

Silvus is seeking a Project Manager who will report directly to the Director of Strategic Initiatives, Operations within the Operations team. The successful candidate will serve as the primary tactical driver assisting the Director of Strategic Initiatives, Operations in translating operational strategy into structured, well-executed projects across multiple key operational domains.

This position is based at Silvus Technologies’ headquarters in West Los Angeles, CA, and operates on a hybrid schedule requiring a minimum of 3 days onsite per week (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays). However, this position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location for candidates based in the Western US region, with a willingness to travel up to 50% of the time to West Los Angeles HQ and local operational sites.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
- Manufacturing Expansion & Optimization: Supporting tactical readiness, facility setup, capacity tracking, and operational ramp-up across local and multi-site manufacturing locations.

- Technology & Digital Transformation: Driving project tracking and cross-functional alignment for business-critical enterprise systems implementations (e.g., ERP, CRM, MES).

- Supply Chain Optimization: Leading projects aimed at maturing forecasting accuracy, process scalability, vendor risk mitigation, dual-sourcing strategies, and procurement frameworks.

- Ad-Hoc Strategic & Operational Priorities : Leading special projects and emerging cross-functional initiatives aligned with evolving business needs and executive leadership priorities.

- Strategic Project Execution:
- Convert broad initiative goals from the Director of Strategic Initiatives, Operations into actionable, resourced project plans with clear milestones and deliverables.

- Track day-to-day workstream execution velocity, driving on-time task completion and proactively clearing operational bottlenecks.

- Maintain executive-level project dashboards, risk logs, and progress metrics to provide full visibility to leadership.

- Cross-Functional Coordination & Governance:
- Serve as the primary cross-functional facilitator between Operations, Engineering, Finance, Sales, and IT to ensure cross-departmental alignment and change adoption.

- Organize regularly scheduled working group meetings, capture clear action items, and ensure team accountability.

- Risk Management & Project Health:
- Proactively identify project dependencies, timeline risks, and resource constraints across operational initiatives, escalating critical blockers early.

- Facilitate risk mitigation strategies with functional leads to keep schedule commitments on track and ensure operational readiness.

- Perform other related duties of which the above are representative.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

- 3–5 years of progressive project management experience within operations, manufacturing, or supply chain.

- Hands-on experience coordinating enterprise technology, business systems, or process-driven software rollouts.

- Proven track record of managing cross-functional project plans, schedules, and deliverables using structured PM methodologies.

- Proficiency with modern project management software (e.g., Jira, Asana, MS Project, SmartSheet) and building executive status dashboards.

- Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to summarize complex risks clearly for cross-functional stakeholders.

- Must be a U.S. Person (U.S. Citizen, or U.S. Permanent Resident) due to clients under U.S. federal contracts.

- All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check and drug test.

- Direct experience managing full lifecycle implementations or major upgrades of core enterprise systems (specifically ERP, CRM, or MES).

- Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), Project Management Professional (PMP), or Lean Six Sigma certification.

- Experience with high-growth, scaling companies in a regulated or complex assembly environment.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Work is performed in a combination of office, warehouse, manufacturing, and home-office environments.
